title: Rate limit each user separately
hints: Leave the global counter alone and add a Map from userId to that user's { windowStart, count }.
The window logic is the same for everyone. Move it into a small helper used by the global bucket and by each user's bucket.
A user's window starts at their first request, so create their bucket the first time you see them.
